headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 22, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates pulled off a stunning upset in the Bronx, defeating the New York Yankees 5-3. Ben Rice led the Pirates' offense with a home run and three RBIs. In other news, the Boston Red Sox secured a 6-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Jake Bennett earning the win and Aroldis Chapman securing the save.

Injuries and availability have impacted several teams, with the Toronto Blue Jays placing left fielder Jonatan Clase on the 10-day injured list due to left plantar fasciitis. The Baltimore Orioles also placed catcher Samuel Basallo on the 10-day injured list with right shoulder inflammation. Other teams have suffered injuries to key players, including the Athletics' J.T. Ginn, Kansas City Royals' Bobby Witt Jr., and Arizona Diamondbacks' Drey Jameson.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place, with the Houston Astros acquiring right-handed pitcher Max Martin in a trade with the Kansas City Royals. The Los Angeles Dodgers also made a move, acquiring right-handed pitcher Seth Halvorsen from the Colorado Rockies. The Chicago Cubs acquired right-handed pitcher Aaron Civale from the Athletics, while the Baltimore Orioles traded for right fielder Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals.

top_news.title: **Pirates Pull Off Upset in Bronx**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 5-3 victory over the New York Yankees, snapping their winning streak. Ben Rice led the Pirates' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall Short in Bronx**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees took a 2-0 lead in the game, ultimately securing a win over the Pittsburgh Pirates. Jasson Domínguez led the Pirates' offense with a single, one RBI, and three at-bats.

top_news.title: **Red Sox Take Down Orioles 6-3**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 6-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Jake Bennett earning the win and Aroldis Chapman securing the save. Christian Encarnacion-Strand led the Orioles' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Orioles Take Down Red Sox 5-1**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 5-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Dylan Beavers leading the team at the plate with 2 hits and 2 RBIs. Kyle Bradish earned the win for the Orioles.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays' Jonatan Clase Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Toronto Blue Jays left fielder Jonatan Clase has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to left plantar fasciitis, effective retroactive to July 21, 2026.

top_news.title: **Astros Acquire RHP Max Martin in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring right-handed pitcher Max Martin in a trade. Martin joins the Astros after being dealt from the Kansas City Royals.
